units.english: Disaster relief to <planet>
units.italian: Soccorso per calamità per <planet>

units.english: A disaster has occurred in a colony on the frontier world of <destination>. Deliver <cargo> to the planet by <date> for <payment>.
units.italian: Una catastrofe ha colpito una colonia sul mondo di frontiera <destination>. Consegna <cargo> sul pianeta entro <date> per <payment>.

units.english: You drop off your cargo of <commodity> and collect your payment of <payment>. A group of <planet> citizens thank you and bid you farewell.
units.italian: Scarichi il tuo carico di <commodity> e ritiri il pagamento di <payment>. Un gruppo di cittadini di <planet> ti ringrazia e ti saluta.

units.english: A novice pilot seeks instruction from an experienced captain, and requests an escort to <stopovers>. After that, return to <origin> and you will receive payment of <payment>.
units.italian: Un pilota alle prime armi cerca istruzione da un capitano esperto e chiede di essere scortato fino a <stopovers>. Dopo di che torna su <origin> e riceverai un pagamento di <payment>.

units.english: After a smooth landing, you guide your student through an especially rough part of the spaceport, full of trash, homeless drifters, and poorly-lit alleyways. You explain the ins and outs of avoiding pickpockets, keeping out of bar fights, and how to spot a lousy deal at an outfitter's shop. After a few hours in one of the seedier parts of the galaxy, both of you are eager to return to <origin>.
units.italian: Dopo un atterraggio morbido, guidi il tuo allievo attraverso una parte particolarmente malfamata dello spazioporto, piena di rifiuti, vagabondi senza casa e vicoli poco illuminati. Gli spieghi i trucchi per evitare i borseggiatori, per tenersi fuori dalle risse nei bar e per riconoscere un affare losco nell'emporio di un fornitore. Dopo qualche ora in una delle zone più squallide della galassia, siete entrambi impazienti di tornare su <origin>.

units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but forgot to escort the <npc> to <stopovers> first! Better head there first.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma hai dimenticato di scortare la <npc> fino a <stopovers>! Meglio andarci prima.

units.english: Your student thanks you for the instruction and for providing a guided view of some of the galaxy's rougher areas. You receive your payment of <payment>.
units.italian: Il tuo allievo ti ringrazia per l'istruzione e per la visita guidata ad alcune delle zone più dure della galassia. Ricevi il pagamento di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|You're having a drink in a dimly lit spaceport bar when you notice a group of young men in crimson leather outfits gambling in a dark corner. The barman eyes them warily. One of them raises his drink and waves you over, beckoning to join their game.|248|0
units.english: You're having a drink in a dimly lit spaceport bar when you notice a group of young men in crimson leather outfits gambling in a dark corner. The barman eyes them warily. One of them raises his drink and waves you over, beckoning to join their game.
units.italian: Stai bevendo qualcosa in un bar dello spazioporto in penombra quando noti un gruppo di giovani in tute di pelle cremisi che giocano d'azzardo in un angolo buio. Il barista li tiene d'occhio con diffidenza. Uno di loro alza il bicchiere e ti fa cenno di avvicinarti, invitandoti a unirti alla partita.

units.english: (Join their game.)
units.italian: (Unisciti alla loro partita.)

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	(Ignore them and leave quickly.)|252|0
units.english: (Ignore them and leave quickly.)
units.italian: (Ignorali e vattene in fretta.)

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	You walk over to the table. A closer examination indicates a strong likelihood that they are pirates; not one of them looks older than 19, and they all sport fearsome tattoos and dangerous-looking sidearms. After a few rounds of cards it becomes abundantly obvious that they're cheating, and making little effort to hide this from you.|256|0
units.english: You walk over to the table. A closer examination indicates a strong likelihood that they are pirates; not one of them looks older than 19, and they all sport fearsome tattoos and dangerous-looking sidearms. After a few rounds of cards it becomes abundantly obvious that they're cheating, and making little effort to hide this from you.
units.italian: Ti avvicini al tavolo. A guardarli bene, è molto probabile che siano pirati: nessuno di loro sembra avere più di 19 anni, e tutti sfoggiano tatuaggi impressionanti e armi corte dall'aria pericolosa. Dopo qualche giro di carte diventa evidentissimo che stanno barando, e che si sforzano poco di nascondertelo.

units.english: good luck
units.italian: good luck

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	Fortunately, you're able to outsmart them anyway and win the game, winding up with a sizable pile of credit chips. They don't look too happy about it, but do not bother you as you quickly leave. You thank your lucky stars: you're nearly 25,000 credits richer and still in one piece after a face-to-face encounter with pirates.|263|0
units.english: Fortunately, you're able to outsmart them anyway and win the game, winding up with a sizable pile of credit chips. They don't look too happy about it, but do not bother you as you quickly leave. You thank your lucky stars: you're nearly 25,000 credits richer and still in one piece after a face-to-face encounter with pirates.
units.italian: Per fortuna riesci comunque a essere più furbo di loro e a vincere la partita, ritrovandoti con una pila considerevole di chip di credito. Non sembrano contenti, ma non ti disturbano mentre te ne vai in fretta. Ringrazi la tua buona stella: sei più ricco di quasi 25.000 crediti e ancora intero dopo un incontro faccia a faccia con dei pirati.

units.english: bad luck
units.italian: bad luck

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	You're starting to bleed money, with more than 10,000 credits in losses already.|267|0
units.english: You're starting to bleed money, with more than 10,000 credits in losses already.
units.italian: Cominci a perdere soldi a vista, con più di 10.000 crediti di perdite.

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	(Call them out on their cheating.)|269|0
units.english: (Call them out on their cheating.)
units.italian: (Accusali di barare.)

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	(Say nothing and continue playing.)|271|0
units.english: (Say nothing and continue playing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla e continua a giocare.)

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	You grit your teeth and lose hand after hand before the game finally ends. The pirates gloat over their "winnings" of almost 15,000 credits as you leave.|277|0
units.english: You grit your teeth and lose hand after hand before the game finally ends. The pirates gloat over their "winnings" of almost 15,000 credits as you leave.
units.italian: Stringi i denti e perdi mano dopo mano finché la partita non finisce. I pirati si godono le loro "vincite" di quasi 15.000 crediti mentre te ne vai.

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	You confront them on their blatant cheating when the meanest-looking one growls at you, "We're just playin' a game here, see? You'd better shut your big mouth if you know what's good for you! We can make this ugly real fast."|281|0
units.english: You confront them on their blatant cheating when the meanest-looking one growls at you, "We're just playin' a game here, see? You'd better shut your big mouth if you know what's good for you! We can make this ugly real fast."
units.italian: Li affronti sul loro palese imbroglio, e il più cattivo del gruppo ti ringhia: "Qui stiamo solo giocando, capito? Meglio che chiudi quella boccaccia, se sai cosa ti conviene! Possiamo renderla brutta molto in fretta."

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	The thugs stare at you menacingly and start to reach for their guns.|282|0
units.english: The thugs stare at you menacingly and start to reach for their guns.
units.italian: I teppisti ti fissano minacciosi e cominciano ad allungare le mani verso le armi.

units.english: (Shoot first!)
units.italian: (Spara per primo!)

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	(Grab the pot and run!)|286|0
units.english: (Grab the pot and run!)
units.italian: (Prendi la posta e scappa!)

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	(Let them fleece me.)|288|0
units.english: (Let them fleece me.)
units.italian: (Lascia che mi spennino.)

units.english: shoot and die
units.italian: shoot and die

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	Unfortunately, they're faster than you. Your mutilated corpse hits the floor with a wet thump.|296|0
units.english: Unfortunately, they're faster than you. Your mutilated corpse hits the floor with a wet thump.
units.italian: Purtroppo sono più veloci di te. Il tuo corpo straziato cade a terra con un tonfo sordo.

units.english: shoot and run
units.italian: shoot and run

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	Grateful that you never leave your ship unarmed, your hand flies toward the pistol at your thigh. You draw the weapon and fire at the pirate who just threatened you. The slug punches a hole in the center of his chest, and he collapses to the ground. His shocked comrades fumble in horror for their weapons, but you've taken them by surprise and quickly gun down another before deciding it's time to escape. You grab some of the credits on the table on the way out!|302|0
units.english: Grateful that you never leave your ship unarmed, your hand flies toward the pistol at your thigh. You draw the weapon and fire at the pirate who just threatened you. The slug punches a hole in the center of his chest, and he collapses to the ground. His shocked comrades fumble in horror for their weapons, but you've taken them by surprise and quickly gun down another before deciding it's time to escape. You grab some of the credits on the table on the way out!
units.italian: Grato di non lasciare mai la tua nave disarmata, la mano ti scatta verso la pistola alla coscia. Estrai l'arma e spari al pirata che ti ha appena minacciato. Il proiettile gli apre un buco in mezzo al petto e lui crolla a terra. I compagni, scioccati, brancolano in cerca delle armi, ma li hai colti di sorpresa e ne abbatti rapidamente un altro prima di decidere che è ora di fuggire. Sulla via d'uscita arraffi un po' dei crediti sul tavolo!

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	You dash toward the hangar bay and blast off in a hurry. You quickly count your spoils and see that you're nearly 25,000 credits richer! Halfway out of the atmosphere, the remaining two pirates hurl obscenities over the comms from their own ships, which are in hot pursuit.|303|0
units.english: You dash toward the hangar bay and blast off in a hurry. You quickly count your spoils and see that you're nearly 25,000 credits richer! Halfway out of the atmosphere, the remaining two pirates hurl obscenities over the comms from their own ships, which are in hot pursuit.
units.italian: Corri verso la baia degli hangar e decolli in fretta. Conti rapidamente il bottino e vedi che sei più ricco di quasi 25.000 crediti! A metà strada fuori dall'atmosfera, i due pirati rimasti ti urlano insulti via radio dalle loro navi, che ti inseguono da vicino.

units.english: grab and die
units.italian: grab and die

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	You grab the pot and make a break for it! The ruffians howl and draw their guns. Dodging gunfire, you run towards the door and get halfway there before one of the slugs finds its mark. You fall to the floor in pain, watching a pool of your own blood expand around you. You try to struggle to your feet, but the toughest-looking pirate kicks you to the ground and finishes you off with another shot.|311|0
units.english: You grab the pot and make a break for it! The ruffians howl and draw their guns. Dodging gunfire, you run towards the door and get halfway there before one of the slugs finds its mark. You fall to the floor in pain, watching a pool of your own blood expand around you. You try to struggle to your feet, but the toughest-looking pirate kicks you to the ground and finishes you off with another shot.
units.italian: Arraffi la posta e ti lanci verso l'uscita! I teppisti ululano e tirano fuori le armi. Schivando i colpi corri verso la porta e arrivi a metà strada prima che uno dei proiettili trovi il segno. Cadi a terra dal dolore e guardi una pozza del tuo stesso sangue allargarsi attorno a te. Provi a rialzarti, ma il pirata dall'aria più dura ti stende con un calcio e ti finisce con un altro colpo.

units.english: grab and run
units.italian: grab and run

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	You grab the pot and make a break for it! The ruffians howl and draw their guns. You run towards the door in a zigzag motion as bullets fly past you and tear chips out of the walls. You glance backwards just in time to see the barkeep reduce one of the ruffians to hamburger meat with an enormous shotgun. The remaining three chase after you.|317|0
units.english: You grab the pot and make a break for it! The ruffians howl and draw their guns. You run towards the door in a zigzag motion as bullets fly past you and tear chips out of the walls. You glance backwards just in time to see the barkeep reduce one of the ruffians to hamburger meat with an enormous shotgun. The remaining three chase after you.
units.italian: Arraffi la posta e ti lanci verso l'uscita! I teppisti ululano e tirano fuori le armi. Corri verso la porta a zigzag mentre i proiettili ti passano accanto e staccano schegge dai muri. Ti volti appena in tempo per vedere il barista ridurre uno dei teppisti a carne trita con un fucile a canne mozze enorme. Gli altri tre ti inseguono.

units.id: mission:Small Pirate gambling|	You dash toward the hangar bay and blast off in a hurry. You quickly count your spoils and see that you're nearly 25,000 credits richer! Halfway out of the atmosphere, you receive a message from the port authorities warning you that while they apprehended two of the pirates, the remaining two made it to their ships and are in hot pursuit.|318|0
units.english: You dash toward the hangar bay and blast off in a hurry. You quickly count your spoils and see that you're nearly 25,000 credits richer! Halfway out of the atmosphere, you receive a message from the port authorities warning you that while they apprehended two of the pirates, the remaining two made it to their ships and are in hot pursuit.
units.italian: Corri verso la baia degli hangar e decolli in fretta. Conti rapidamente il bottino e vedi che sei più ricco di quasi 25.000 crediti! A metà strada fuori dall'atmosfera ricevi un messaggio delle autorità del porto che ti avverte: due dei pirati sono stati fermati, ma gli altri due hanno raggiunto le loro navi e ti inseguono da vicino.
